steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: seed-one-item
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id: 'u-sofa', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9, 3], rotation: 0, props: {} }]); window.__store.getState().setSelectedItemIds(['u-sofa'])

steps.name: nudge-burst
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { st.pushHistoryCoalesced('nudge'); st.refreshCoalesce('nudge'); st.moveItem('u-sofa', [9 + (i + 1) * 0.2, 3]); } })()

steps.name: assert-burst-one-entry
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__store.getState().past.length; if (p !== 1) throw new Error('nudge burst should be ONE undo entry, got ' + p); })()

steps.name: assert-burst-reverted
steps.eval: (() => { const it = window.__store.getState().items.find(i => i.id === 'u-sofa'); if (Math.abs(it.position[0] - 9) > 1e-9) throw new Error('one undo should revert the whole burst to x=9, got x=' + it.position[0]); if (window.__store.getState().past.length !== 0) throw new Error('past should be empty after undo'); })()

steps.name: reset-for-array
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id: 'u-sofa', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9, 3], rotation: 0, props: {} }]); window.__store.getState().clearHistory()

steps.name: array-commit
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); st.pushHistory(); const src = st.items[0]; const copies = [1,2,3].map(n => ({ ...src, id: 'u-arr-' + n, position: [src.position[0], src.position[1] + n * 1.2], groupId: 'g1' })); st.setItems([{ ...src, groupId: 'g1' }, ...copies]); })()

steps.name: assert-array-one-entry
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); if (st.past.length !== 1) throw new Error('array should be ONE undo entry, got ' + st.past.length); if (st.items.length !== 4) throw new Error('expected 4 items after array, got ' + st.items.length); })()

steps.name: assert-array-reverted
steps.eval: (() => { const n = window.__store.getState().items.length; if (n !== 1) throw new Error('one undo should remove all array copies, expected 1 item, got ' + n); })()
